description: Read the connected store's own catalogue: title, bullets, description, status, price, currency and Amazon listing issues. connectionId is optional when one store is connected; with several, the answer lists them and asks you to choose. query (Amazon: exact SKU; Shopify: product search), limit (up to 50), cursor from nextCursor, productRef to read one product by SKU or GID, includeIssues, includePricing (Amazon). For Amazon, source "report" reads the whole catalogue through a report: it answers status in_progress with a reportId and poll arguments until done. Read-only. No cost to call. Use when the user asks about the products in their connected store.

connectionId.description: Store connection id; optional when one store is connected.

marketplaceId.description: Amazon marketplace id; defaults to the first.

productRef.description: Amazon SKU or Shopify product GID to read one product.

query.description: Amazon: exact SKU. Shopify: product search query.

reportId.description: Report id from an in_progress answer.

name: list_store_products
title: List Store Products
